feature_queries.name: user_profile
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.user, e.timestamp, u.birthyear, (EXTRACT(year FROM e.timestamp) - u.birthyear) AS age, u.timezone, u.gender, u.locale, u.location, DATE_DIFF('day', u.joinedAt, e.timestamp) AS days_since_joined
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = e.user

feature_queries.name: time_features
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  user,
  timestamp,
  EXTRACT(dow FROM timestamp) AS dow,
  EXTRACT(month FROM timestamp) AS month,
  EXTRACT(hour FROM timestamp) AS hour
FROM eval_table

feature_queries.name: invite_windows
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (SELECT user, timestamp FROM eval_table), ei AS (
  SELECT
    user, timestamp, invited, interested, not_interested,
    CASE WHEN invited = 1 AND interested = 0 AND not_interested = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ignored
  FROM event_interest
)
SELECT
  b.user, b.timestamp,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ei.invited=1 AND ei.timestamp >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' AND ei.timestamp < b.timestamp) AS invited_7d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ei.ignored=1 AND ei.timestamp >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' AND ei.timestamp < b.timestamp) AS ignored_7d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ei.invited=1 AND ei.timestamp >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND ei.timestamp < b.timestamp) AS invited_30d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ei.ignored=1 AND ei.timestamp >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND ei.timestamp < b.timestamp) AS ignored_30d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ei.invited=1 AND ei.timestamp >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND ei.timestamp < b.timestamp) AS invited_90d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ei.ignored=1 AND ei.timestamp >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND ei.timestamp < b.timestamp) AS ignored_90d,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ei.invited=1 AND ei.timestamp >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND ei.timestamp < b.timestamp) > 0
    THEN (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ei.ignored=1 AND ei.timestamp >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND ei.timestamp < b.timestamp) * 1.0) /
         (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ei.invited=1 AND ei.timestamp >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND ei.timestamp < b.timestamp) * 1.0)
  END AS ignored_rate_30d
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN ei ON ei.user=b.user AND ei.timestamp < b.timestamp
GROUP BY b.user, b.timestamp

feature_queries.name: attendance_windows_plus
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (SELECT user, timestamp FROM eval_table), agg AS (
SELECT
  b.user, b.timestamp,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ea.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND ea.start_time < b.timestamp) AS att_rows_30d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ea.status='yes' AND ea.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND ea.start_time < b.timestamp) AS att_yes_30d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ea.status='no' AND ea.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND ea.start_time < b.timestamp) AS att_no_30d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ea.status='maybe' AND ea.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND ea.start_time < b.timestamp) AS att_maybe_30d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ea.status='invited' AND ea.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND ea.start_time < b.timestamp) AS att_invited_30d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ea.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND ea.start_time < b.timestamp) AS att_rows_90d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ea.status='yes' AND ea.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND ea.start_time < b.timestamp) AS att_yes_90d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ea.status='no' AND ea.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND ea.start_time < b.timestamp) AS att_no_90d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ea.status='maybe' AND ea.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND ea.start_time < b.timestamp) AS att_maybe_90d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ea.status='invited' AND ea.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND ea.start_time < b.timestamp) AS att_invited_90d,
  MIN(DATE_DIFF('day', ea.start_time, b.timestamp)) AS days_since_last_event_start
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN event_attendees ea
  ON ea.user_id=b.user AND ea.start_time < b.timestamp
GROUP BY b.user, b.timestamp
)
SELECT
  user, timestamp,
  *,
  CASE WHEN (att_yes_30d + att_no_30d + att_maybe_30d) > 0 THEN att_no_30d * 1.0 / (att_yes_30d + att_no_30d + att_maybe_30d) END AS no_rate_30d,
  CASE WHEN (att_yes_90d + att_no_90d + att_maybe_90d) > 0 THEN att_no_90d * 1.0 / (att_yes_90d + att_no_90d + att_maybe_90d) END AS no_rate_90d,
  CASE WHEN att_rows_30d > 0 THEN att_invited_30d * 1.0 / att_rows_30d END AS invited_share_30d,
  CASE WHEN att_rows_90d > 0 THEN att_invited_90d * 1.0 / att_rows_90d END AS invited_share_90d
FROM agg

feature_queries.name: friend_stats
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (SELECT user, timestamp FROM eval_table)
SELECT
  b.user, b.timestamp,
  COUNT(uf.friend) AS n_friends
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN user_friends uf ON uf.user=b.user
GROUP BY b.user, b.timestamp
